args.lesson: Worked: one reaction-sorted GitHub search with repo exclusions was readable and screening the 5 top bodies offline was enough, with 0 extra FETCHes used. Failed: sorting by reactions brings up crowdfunds and token pools (RustChain RTC at a '$0.10 internal reference', a tdesktop fork offering ETH/USDC, a 2018 bitcoin.org issue from a non-sponsor). All five pay in crypto, have 23-257 comments, and are unbounded or excluded. Next time: drop generic GitHub bounty search as a revenue channel. Only reconsider for a specific upstream, maintainer-funded fiat bounty with fewer than 5 attempts, plus a founder-approved GitHub identity. Spend turns on the live offers and inbound fulfillment instead.
